description: Kabo Codex plugin lifecycle hooks. SessionStart syncs skills and revocations. PostToolUse (type: command) stages connector envelopes so the model does not retype them, installs downloaded skill packages (unpack + signature/revocation verification) so package bytes never pass through a terminal, and checks and caches each deferred skill asset fetched with registry_skill_asset (digest + local signature verification); Codex 0.154 parses that event. Never add PostToolUseFailure (not in the Codex event enum) or mcp_tool — an unknown event or handler type makes this whole file unparseable and silently disables SessionStart, i.e. skill sync and revocations (real incident, 2026-08-18). Usage telemetry is therefore not collected on the Codex variant until the host offers an MCP-capable hook type; the platform records tool-level telemetry server-side and treats client usage events as optional. Since 2026-09-03 that also covers skill-verify failures: this variant holds no credential of its own, so it cannot relay them the way the Claude variant does (kabo-headers --relay), and the injected-prompt relay it used to depend on asked the model to act on injected instructions - it stopped collecting them instead. The KABO_VERIFY_FAIL line on stderr is the local signal.
